title: Optimize on the explicitly selected GFN2/ZAFF cubic-refit surface
summary: Optimize on the explicitly selected GFN2/ZAFF cubic-refit surface. The contract registers the existing owner API and does not certify the accuracy of a particular molecular calculation.
gates: Require the fitted cubic-refit field and its immutable reference
Select the exact declared composite backend without fallback
Accept a minimum only through LINK stationary-point gates
coordinate_policy: Preserve the ordered molecular identity, isotope masses, coordinate frame and declared owner representation; no geometry remapping or method substitution is implicit.
backend_policy: The scientific owner validates the inputs and numerical controls. Any missing electronic-structure acquisition uses the separately authorized calculation gateway; registration alone launches nothing.
